contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #199: Counterexamples to Auslander–Reiten, Tachikawa and related homological conjectures.
Exact audit of AR coc:data and lift:main over k=F_2(q,H_1,H_2), for every H in k^*, with the staged 20-dimensional T and all 179 cochain entries.

definitions.p: the full table and zero convention in AR build/09-cochain.tex
definitions.C,T,P: the algebra, trivial extension, and relative bar resolution in AR build/03-algebra.tex
definitions.A,X,K: the tensor-square algebra, f-simple tensor square, and two-cone complex in AR build/04-resolution.tex and 05-cones.tex

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 199 (Counterexamples to Auslander–Reiten, Tachikawa and related homological conjectures.; papers: An explicit counterexample to the Auslander-Reiten conjecture; A counterexample to Tachikawa's second conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/199.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
AR alg:C and alg:T: the displayed table defines an associative ten-dimensional C, and T=C lt DC is symmetric of dimension twenty with the stated radical and trace-dual basis.

AR coc:data: p has weight -1, is a Hochschild cocycle, evaluates nontrivially on s in Ext_T^3(s,s), and for every H in k^* satisfies sum_w p(a,b,h_H(w))w^*=a z_H(b)+z_H(ab)+z_H(a)h_H^{-1}(b) for every a,b in rad T.
AR res:base, res:polynomial, res:tensor: the displayed C-resolution and its dual calculation give Ext_T^*(s,s)=k[tau], |tau|=3, and nonnegative stable self-Hom_A(X,X)=k[tau_1,tau_2].

AR cone:finite and cone:profile: K has finite side-projective stable representative Ccal, and stable Hom_A(X,Ccal X[a]) is k at a=0,3 and zero otherwise; its degree-three top projection is an isomorphism to H^{-1}.

AR lift:main: for every H in k^* there is f_H: A_(h_H tensor h_H) -> Ccal[3] whose top projection is beta_H(1)=xi_H tensor xi_H; evaluation on X sends 1 to H^2(F tensor F) in Omega X and is nonzero modulo projective factorizations.

AR branch:finite-fiber, branch:profile, branch:comparison: the finite side-projective fiber yields delta^0 surjective with one-dimensional kernel and delta^a an isomorphism for every a>0, using the distinct H_i^{-m} twisting scalars.

AR conv:proposition: for symmetric A and side-projective F the stated comparison-map hypotheses produce a finite nonprojective Gorenstein-projective triangular-algebra module Z with Ext^i(Z,Z)=Ext^i(Z,Lambda)=0 for all i>0.

AR thm:main: over F_2(q,H_1,H_2) there is a finite-dimensional algebra Lambda and nonprojective Gorenstein-projective module Z with both positive Ext vanishings, Lambda/rad Lambda=k^8 and rad(Lambda)^4 nonzero, persisting under every field extension.
Tachikawa a:table, a:dual-dimensions, a:resolution: the ten-dimensional C has the displayed resolutions and both dual regular-module projective-dimension bounds at most two.
Tachikawa e:polynomial, e:all-degrees, e:socle, e:twists: H^{3m}=P_m, H^{-3m-1}=D P_m, other degrees vanish, the socle class is nonzero, and U_H acts by H^{-m} and H^{m+2} respectively.

Tachikawa b:bimodule, b:trace-obstruction, b:stable-adjunction, b:evaluated-lift: a finite side-projective Y has stable Hom profile k in degrees -3,0 and zero otherwise, with a nonzero evaluated ordinary map U_H -> Y for every H in k^*.
Tachikawa t:comparison-maps, t:finite-module, t:vanishing: the triangular cone produces nonprojective Z with totally acyclic resolution and self-Hom cohomology k in degrees -1,0 and zero otherwise.

Tachikawa tr:transfer: for a totally acyclic resolution of nonprojective Z, vanishing in all positive degrees and all degrees <=-2 implies that induction to R lt DR is nonprojective and has no positive self-Ext.
Tachikawa thm:main: a finite-dimensional symmetric algebra over F_2(q,H_1,H_2) has a finite-dimensional nonprojective module M with Ext^i(M,M)=0 for every i>0.

The literal AR algebra and all 179 cochain entries satisfy associativity, trace-duality, endpoints, weight, all 104976 cocycle equations, all 324 twisted boundary equations coefficientwise in F_2[q,H], and the displayed cycle evaluates to q^3 f.

For the literal twisted relative bar resolutions, B_i has dB+Bd=D_b in every nonnegative degree; the boundary identity yields bimodule maps G_i in every degree with pB=dG+Gd; their tensor combination has only the degree-zero top-cell defect and therefore induces the prescribed stable tail lift.
For every H in k^*, beta_H evaluated on X has value H^2(F tensor F), is nonzero, and every map from X to rad(A)(f tensor f) factoring through a finite projective A-module is zero.

Lemma coc:data and Proposition lift:main hold literally over F_2(q,H_1,H_2), with all degrees and every nonzero H, independently of the unverified polynomial self-Ext and full cone-profile calculations.

In a ring with a cyclic nondegenerate trace, an element killed on the left by a two-sided ideal also kills that ideal on the right; consequently any map from an ideal-annihilated module into that ideal factoring through a finite free module is zero. This supplies the stable nonfactorization core used for the literal H^2(F tensor F) evaluation.

For arbitrary graded modules over a ring, an augmented degree-two chain map with a boundary augmentation admits a single homotopy in every natural-number degree when the target augmented complex is exact and every source module is projective. Also, a cyclic nondegenerate trace turns left annihilation of a two-sided ideal into right annihilation, forcing every finite-free factorization from an ideal-annihilated module into the ideal to vanish.

import Mathlib

namespace TwistedLift

open LinearMap

section ProjectiveLifting

variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]
variable {M N Q : Type*}
variable [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
variable [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module.Projective R Q]

theorem lift_to_range (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : Q →ₗ[R] N)
    (h : LinearMap.range g ≤ LinearMap.range f) :
    ∃ l : Q →ₗ[R] M, f.comp l = g := by
  let g' : Q →ₗ[R] LinearMap.range f :=
    g.codRestrict (LinearMap.range f) (fun x => h ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property
    f.rangeRestrict g' f.surjective_rangeRestrict
  refine ⟨l, ?_⟩
  ext x
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (DFunLike.congr_fun hl x)

end ProjectiveLifting

section AllDegrees

variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]
variable {P Q : ℕ → Type*}
variable [∀ n, AddCommGroup (P n)] [∀ n, Module R (P n)]
variable [∀ n, AddCommGroup (Q n)] [∀ n, Module R (Q n)]
variable [∀ n, Module.Projective R (Q n)]

theorem augmented_nullhomotopy
    (d : ∀ n, P (n + 1) →ₗ[R] P n)
    (e : ∀ n, Q (n + 1) →ₗ[R] Q n)
    (f : ∀ n, Q (n + 1) →ₗ[R] P (n + 1))
    (z : Q 0 →ₗ[R] P 0)
    (haug : Function.Surjective (d 0))
    (hexact : ∀ n, LinearMap.range (d (n + 1)) = LinearMap.ker (d n))
    (hsquare : ∀ n, (e n).comp (e (n + 1)) = 0)
    (hchain : ∀ n, (d (n + 1)).comp (f (n + 1)) =
      (f n).comp (e (n + 1)))
    (hboundary : (d 0).comp (f 0) = z.comp (e 0)) :
    ∃ G : ∀ n, Q n →ₗ[R] P (n + 1),
      (d 0).comp (G 0) = z ∧
      ∀ n, (d (n + 1)).comp (G (n + 1)) + (G n).comp (e n) = f n := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g0, hg0⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (d 0) z haug
  let S (n : ℕ) :=
    {g : Q n →ₗ[R] P (n + 1) //
      (d n).comp (f n - g.comp (e n)) = 0}
  have hbase : (d 0).comp (f 0 - g0.comp (e 0)) = 0 := by
    ext x
    have hf := DFunLike.congr_fun hboundary x
    have hg := DFunLike.congr_fun hg0 (e 0 x)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hf hg
    change d 0 (f 0 x - g0 (e 0 x)) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hf, hg, sub_self]
  have step : ∀ n, ∀ s : S n, ∃ t : S (n + 1),
      (d (n + 1)).comp t.val = f n - s.val.comp (e n) := by
    intro n s
    have hrange : LinearMap.range (f n - s.val.comp (e n)) ≤
        LinearMap.range (d (n + 1)) := by
      rw [hexact n]
      rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
      change d n ((f n - s.val.comp (e n)) x) = 0
      have h := DFunLike.congr_fun s.property x
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] using h
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := lift_to_range (d (n + 1))
      (f n - s.val.comp (e n)) hrange
    have hinv : (d (n + 1)).comp (f (n + 1) - g.comp (e (n + 1))) = 0 := by
      ext x
      have hf := DFunLike.congr_fun (hchain n) x
      have he := DFunLike.congr_fun (hsquare n) x
      have hl := DFunLike.congr_fun hg (e (n + 1) x)
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hf
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at he
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply] at hl
      rw [he, map_zero, sub_zero] at hl
      change d (n + 1) (f (n + 1) x - g (e (n + 1) x)) = 0
      rw [map_sub, hf, hl, sub_self]
    exact ⟨⟨g, hinv⟩, hg⟩
  let next (n : ℕ) (s : S n) : S (n + 1) := Classical.choose (step n s)
  let seq : ∀ n, S n :=
    fun n => Nat.rec (motive := S) ⟨g0, hbase⟩ (fun i s => next i s) n
  refine ⟨fun n => (seq n).val, hg0, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have h := Classical.choose_spec (step n (seq n))
  change (d (n + 1)).comp (next n (seq n)).val +
    (seq n).val.comp (e n) = f n
  rw [h, sub_add_cancel]

end AllDegrees

section SymmetricTrace

variable {R K : Type*} [Ring R] [Zero K]

theorem left_annihilator_kills_right
    (tr : R → K) (hzero : tr 0 = 0)
    (hcyclic : ∀ a b, tr (a * b) = tr (b * a))
    (hnondegenerate : ∀ u, (∀ a, tr (a * u) = 0) → u = 0)
    (J : R → Prop) (hclosed : ∀ j, J j → ∀ a, J (j * a))
    (u : R) (hu : ∀ j, J j → j * u = 0) :
    ∀ j, J j → u * j = 0 := by
  intro j hj
  apply hnondegenerate
  intro a
  calc
    tr (a * (u * j)) = tr ((j * a) * u) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, hcyclic (a * u) j, ← mul_assoc]
    _ = tr 0 := by rw [hu (j * a) (hclosed j hj a)]
    _ = 0 := hzero

variable {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

theorem finite_free_factorization_vanishes
    (tr : R → K) (hzero : tr 0 = 0)
    (hcyclic : ∀ a b, tr (a * b) = tr (b * a))
    (hnondegenerate : ∀ u, (∀ a, tr (a * u) = 0) → u = 0)
    (J : R → Prop) (hclosed : ∀ j, J j → ∀ a, J (j * a))
    (hannihilates : ∀ j, J j → ∀ x : M, j • x = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (α : M →ₗ[R] (Fin n → R)) (β : (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] R)
    (himage : ∀ v, J (β v)) :
    β.comp α = 0 := by
  classical
  ext x
  have hsum : α x = ∑ t : Fin n, (α x t) • Pi.single t (1 : R) := by
    ext t
    simp [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]
  change β (α x) = 0
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro t _
  rw [map_smul]
  change (α x t) * β (Pi.single t 1) = 0
  apply left_annihilator_kills_right tr hzero hcyclic hnondegenerate J hclosed
  · intro j hj
    have h : j • α x = 0 := by
      rw [← α.map_smul j x, hannihilates j hj x, map_zero]
    have ht := congrArg (fun v : Fin n → R => v t) h
    simpa using ht
  · exact himage _

end SymmetricTrace

theorem twist_square_nonzero {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : k} (hH : H ≠ 0) :
    H * H ≠ 0 :=
  mul_ne_zero hH hH

end TwistedLift
